principles: Synthetic events are fixtures, never proof of distribution or demand.
An observed outcome requires an approved send or released canonical source plus a durable receiving-system receipt.
Door attribution is a classification aid, not consent to send or a claim that a lead was captured.

door_tags.success_signal: attributable inbound initiated from that canonical source
door_tags.stop_rule: pause on source drift, missing approval, or no qualified signal in the review window
